characters.name: KOER MUKI
characters.description: Väike pruun koer valgete käppadega, pehmete rippuvate kõrvade ja lühikese sabaga, kandmas rohelist kaelarihma. Armas ja rõõmsameelne multifilmi stiilis tegelane.

characters.name: KASS KISSI
characters.description: Väike valge kass roosade kõrvade ja pika koheva sabaga, kandmas väikest sinist rusetti kaelas. Armas ja uudishimulik multifilmi stiilis tegelane.

locations.name: Sügisene aed
locations.description: Autumn backyard garden with green grass partially covered in yellow and orange autumn leaves, colorful maple trees with yellow leaves in the background, a low wooden fence on the left, a cozy red wooden house visible on the right, warm autumn sunlight. Cartoon style.

pages.text: KOER MUKI JA KASS KISSI ON AIAS.
pages.scene: Koer Muki, a small brown dog with white paws and green collar, and Kass Kissi, a small white cat with a blue bow, are standing together on a green lawn in a sunny autumn garden. Orange and yellow leaves lie scattered on the grass around them. A cozy red wooden cottage is in the background. Both characters look excited and happy. LANDSCAPE composition.

Close-up perspective of Koer Muki and Kass Kissi looking down at the lawn covered with bright yellow, orange, and red fallen leaves. Koer Muki points at a group of colorful leaves with his paw. Kass Kissi looks curious with wide eyes. Warm sunlight illuminates the vibrant autumn colors. LANDSCAPE composition.

Koer Muki uses his front paws to scrape and gather a pile of bright yellow and orange leaves into a neat, large leaf pile in the center of the garden. Kass Kissi stands nearby watching Muki with a delighted smile. Warm autumn sunlight streams onto the leaf pile. LANDSCAPE composition.

Kass Kissi walks toward the leaf pile carrying a light yellow toy plastic rake in her paws to help gather remaining leaves. Koer Muki smiles and claps his paws encouragingly beside the big mound of autumn leaves. The red wooden house and wooden fence are visible in the clean, cheerful background. LANDSCAPE composition.

Kass Kissi leaps happily into the middle of the huge pile of yellow and orange leaves, splashing leaves into the air. Koer Muki stands right next to the pile, wagging his tail in excitement. Leaves swirl softly around Kissi as she lands in the soft pile. LANDSCAPE composition.

Koer Muki and Kass Kissi are both sitting in the big pile of autumn leaves, tossing armfuls of bright yellow and red leaves high into the air. Colorful leaves flutter down like confetti around both smiling characters. LANDSCAPE composition.

A wider view of the garden showing colorful autumn leaves flying and floating gently everywhere in the air around Koer Muki and Kass Kissi. Both animals are laughing and looking up at the swirling golden leaves in the warm sunlight. LANDSCAPE composition.

pages.text: MUKI JA KISSI ON VÄGA ÕNNELIKUD.
pages.scene: Koer Muki and Kass Kissi sit together side by side on the grass, cozy in the autumn garden with leaves scattered all around them. Muki puts an arm over Kissi's shoulder, and both characters are smiling brightly at the reader. A golden autumn tree stands behind them. LANDSCAPE composition.
